items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Mm, that's about right. Yeah, there was a lot of them that I knew in here. There was a... There's a fellow that... I don't know if you all have known him. [INTERVIEWER] Johnny St. Cyr. Yes, I know him very well. [INTERVIEWEE] And I know that there was the old line with Ben. Oh, yes.
